text:
maria: Kicking off a small canary for orion-quant-v2 in us-west1 at 11:00 PT. Traffic throttle to 3 qps, short grace window (15m). Fallback order planned: orion-v1-quant -> lumen-float32 -> orion-default. Tagging @kevin @oliver to watch latency and error budget.

deploy-bot: [11:00 PT] Canary deploy initiated: orion-quant-v2 -> region=us-west1, target_qps=3, rollout=canary. Logs: https://deployments.internal/r/3032104567

kevin: quick note — can we prefer lumen-float32 before orion-v1-quant for low-latency user paths? lumen has better 95p for <512 tokens. Otherwise :+1:. Also we should pin dedicated customers to orion-v1 until we validate outputs.

maria: good call. updating fallback ordering to: lumen-float32 -> orion-v1-quant -> orion-default. will pin dedicated scope. adding a short diff to the rollout config now.

oliver: Heads-up to support: please prep a short FAQ for customers who see slight token drift. Add example prompt comparisons. @support-team

sre-oncall: If error_rate > 0.8% or p95 latency increases > 150ms vs baseline, we auto-throttle to 1 qps and rollback to previous model. I'll attach alert rule IDs in a sec.

maria: alert rules: infra.alerts#MQ-21 (error_rate), infra.alerts#LAT-77 (p95). Canary config snippet:```yaml
canary:
  model: "orion-quant-v2"
  region: "us-west1"
  max_qps: 3
  concurrency: 8
  fallback_order: ["lumen-float32", "orion-v1-quant", "orion-default"]
  dedicated_pin: true
  grace_window_minutes: 15
```

kevin: runbook steps for pinning (for ops):```bash
# pin for dedicated customers
rw-cli catalog pin --model orion-quant-v2 --scope dedicated --until 2026-04-01
# quick rollback
rw-cli catalog unpin --model orion-quant-v2 --force && rw-cli catalog promote --model orion-v1-quant
```

support-team: We have a short FAQ draft, will post in #support later. Also prepping a canned responder for users who file drift tickets.

deploy-bot: [11:12 PT] Canary traffic at 20% of target (0.6 qps observed), no errors. Telemetry: p95=220ms (+20ms), error_rate=0.12%.

sre-oncall: monitoring — p95 trending, but within guardrails. keeping watch for 11:15 spike.

maria: thanks team. If nothing critical by 11:30 PT we graduate to 50% throttle (1.5 qps) for another 30m, then decide full enable. Will update release notes: "catalog: enable orion-quant-v2 (canary) — fallback ordering updated; dedicated customers pinned to orion-v1 until validated."

kevin: after graduation, schedule a short sync with product to confirm quality signoff before full roll.

maria: agreed. closing thread for now — will post final cutover summary or rollback note in this thread. :white_check_mark:
